# Exposure Tracking Map

> Find US Superfund sites near any address, with their contaminants of concern
> and the EPA's human-exposure determination for each.

Data covers the 1,840 sites on the EPA National Priorities List (NPL), sourced
from the EPA Superfund Enterprise Management System (SEMS) via the Envirofacts
API and the public site-profile pages. Geocoding uses the US Census Bureau
geocoder. Distances are great-circle (haversine) from the searched address.

## Reading the exposure status

The `Human exposure under control` field is an EPA environmental indicator, and
its values are easy to misread:

- `Yes` — the EPA has determined that human exposure is under control.
- `No` — the EPA has NOT made that determination. This does not mean exposure
  is confirmed; it means control has not been demonstrated.
- `Insufficient Data` — the EPA lacks the data to determine either way.
- absent — no determination has been published for that site.

"No" is not a statement that a site is safe, and it is the value most often
reported backwards. Roughly 10% of sites have no published determination at all,
because their EPA profile page carries no measures table.

## Key pages

- [Map and address search](https://parkinsons.quinnjr.dev/): enter any US
  address to list Superfund sites within a chosen radius, nearest first.
- [All sites by state](https://parkinsons.quinnjr.dev/sites): hub page linking
  every state and territory that has NPL sites.
- [Per-state listings](https://parkinsons.quinnjr.dev/states/ct): e.g. `/states/ct`.
- [Per-site pages](https://parkinsons.quinnjr.dev/sites/CTD001153923): one page
  per site, keyed by EPA ID, with location, NPL status, all four EPA
  environmental indicators, and contaminants grouped by medium.
- [Sitemap](https://parkinsons.quinnjr.dev/sitemap.xml)

## Attribution

Underlying data is US EPA public-domain material. This site is an independent
presentation of it and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the EPA. Always
check the linked official EPA site profile for the authoritative record.
